exposure: Preferences for oral intake during labour
Experiences of oral intake during labour
Recalled advice about oral intake during labour
outcome: Receipt of advice on oral intake during labour
cohort: The study included 149 women (mean age 31 years, median gestation 39 weeks) who had recently experienced labour at a tertiary women's hospital and completed a postpartum survey.
finding: Most women felt like drinking but not eating during labour, experienced varying gastrointestinal symptoms (61% nausea, 32% vomiting), and received inconsistent advice on oral intake during labour from various sources.
